ns2:section.sectionText: Initially, this section is reserved exclusively for students who were registered for Math 446 as of July 31, 2020. If space is available as of August 14, 2020, seats will be added in self-service or this message will be updated by August 15. Note: while online classes are not limited by fire codes, space is limited due to availability of grading, office hours, and instructor availability to address student questions.
